a.lede: Nine years after its reveal, the overdue Roadster is set to debut on Thursday to an EV market that has grown skeptical of electric hypercars.
a.title: Tesla’s Roadster 2 Is Late—and Entering a Different EV World

b.lede: The automaker unveiled its next luxury sports car at an event in Texas. It has thrusters on it that can send it airborne.
b.title: The Tesla Roadster 2 Is Here—and It Flies
